heading: Places of training
lead: The Secretary of Transportation may provide for the training of students attending a State maritime academy—

tree.text: on vessels owned or subsidized by the United States Government;
on other documented vessels, with the permission of the owner; and
in shipyards or plants and with industrial or educational organizations.

L. 96–453, § 2, Oct. 15, 1980, 94 Stat. 2003. In paragraph (2), the words “with the permission of the owner” are substituted for “if the owner . . . cooperates in such use” for clarity.
